packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates by manager — keeps majors as individual PRs for review. Specific rules below override per Renovate's last-rule-wins semantics.
Flag major version bumps for human review. automerge is already false by default; the label surfaces majors on the dashboard.

Keep the Playwright pins in one PR. @axe-core/playwright declares playwright-core as a peer dependency, and CI installs the browser with `playwright install`, so the runner, the browser build, and the axe integration must move together. Must stay after the group-by-manager rule to win under last-rule-wins.

customManagers.description: Track the Hugo release pinned in .hugo-version — a bare version string no built-in manager sees. The Pages workflow reads this same file to build its download URL, so one bump moves the local toolchain and CI together.
